scientific_name: Xerochrysum bracteatum, Gomphrena globosa, Celosia argentea, and Limonium sinuatum
notes: A dense dried arrangement layers burgundy and blush strawflowers with globe amaranth, salmon celosia spikes, blue-purple statice, mustard button flowers, tiny white blossoms, and pale oat stems. Its dusty jewel tones and varied seed-head textures create an abundant, preserved composition.
